<?php
class O { public $back; function __destruct(){echo "D;";} }
function &f(){$x=new O;$x->back=$GLOBALS['w'];try{return $x;}finally{unset($x);echo "U;";Fiber::suspend();}}
$w=new Fiber(function(){$r=&f();echo "R;";});$w->start();echo "B:",(int)$w->isSuspended(),";";unset($w);echo "L;";gc_collect_cycles();echo "G;";gc_collect_cycles();echo "E;";

<?php
class O { public $back; function __destruct(){echo "D;";} }
function &f(){$x=new O;$x->back=null;try{return $x;}finally{unset($x);echo "U;";Fiber::suspend();}}
$w=new Fiber(function(){$r=&f();echo "R;";});$w->start();echo "B:",(int)$w->isSuspended(),";";unset($w);echo "L;";gc_collect_cycles();echo "G;";gc_collect_cycles();echo "E;";
